name: Minecraft Paper
author: maximilian.rade@gmail.com
description: High-performance Minecraft Java server based on Paper. The settings below are written into server.properties on every start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

API=https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper
UA="pelican-egg-minecraft-paper"

if [ -z "${PAPER_VERSION}" ] || [ "${PAPER_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    # newest first; ids with a dash are pre-releases and release candidates
    PAPER_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL -A "$UA" "$API/versions" | jq -r '[.versions[].version.id | select(test("-") | not)][0]')
fi

BUILD=${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}
BUILD_JSON=$(curl -fsSL -A "$UA" "$API/versions/${PAPER_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}")
URL=$(echo "$BUILD_JSON" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].url // empty')
SHA=$(echo "$BUILD_JSON" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].checksums.sha256 // empty')

if [ -z "$URL" ] || [ -z "$SHA" ]; then
    echo "No Paper download found for version ${PAPER_VERSION}, build ${BUILD}"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading Paper ${PAPER_VERSION} build $(echo "$BUILD_JSON" | jq -r '.id')"
curl -fsSL -A "$UA" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "$URL" || exit 1
echo "${SHA}  ${SERVER_JARFILE}" | sha256sum -c - || exit 1

echo 'Install Complete'

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The jar file to run.

variables.name: Paper Version
variables.description: Minecraft version, or latest.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: Paper build number, or latest.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Message shown under the server name in the multiplayer list.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players online at the same time.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: peaceful, easy, normal or hard.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Default game mode for new players: survival, creative, adventure or spectator.

variables.name: Force Gamemode
variables.description: Put players back into the default game mode every time they join.

variables.name: Hardcore
variables.description: Difficulty locked to hard, players become spectators when they die. Only applies when the world is created.

variables.name: Level Name
variables.description: Name of the world folder. Changing it loads or creates a different world.

variables.name: Level Seed
variables.description: Seed for a new world, empty for a random one. Only applies when the world is created.

variables.name: Level Type
variables.description: World generator: minecraft:normal, minecraft:flat, minecraft:large_biomes, minecraft:amplified or minecraft:single_biome_surface. Only applies when the world is created.

variables.name: Generate Structures
variables.description: Generate villages, strongholds and other structures. Only applies to newly generated chunks.

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: Only players on the whitelist can join.

variables.name: Enforce Whitelist
variables.description: Kick online players who are not on the whitelist when it is reloaded.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Verify players against Mojang's servers. Only turn this off behind a proxy like Velocity - otherwise anyone can join under any name, including an operator's.

variables.name: Allow Flight
variables.description: Allow flying in survival, e.g. for plugins. When off, players who fly too long get kicked.

variables.name: Spawn Protection
variables.description: Radius around spawn in which only operators can build. 0 disables it.

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: How many chunks around a player are sent to the client (3-32).

variables.name: Simulation Distance
variables.description: How many chunks around a player are actively simulated (3-32).

variables.name: Pause When Empty
variables.description: Seconds without any player before the server pauses ticking. 0 disables it.

variables.name: Enable Query
variables.description: Answer status queries over UDP on the game port - no extra allocation needed. Gives the Game Query plugin the full player list.

variables.name: Enable RCON
variables.description: Remote console access. Only starts when an RCON password is set.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Port for RCON. Needs its own allocation if RCON should be reachable from outside the server.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for RCON. RCON does not start without one.
